summary: Alberta Parks page (updated May 28, 2026), booking site and park map read. Confirmed $40 power / $48 power-and-water, showers, flush toilets, dump, store, reservable. Season written from the page: May 14 - Oct 13 (2026). Changed sites 115 -> 105 RV sites (plus 12 walk-in tent); wrote 30-amp, water at 26 sites, no sewer, max 61 ft. One campground in the park. The stored pin is about 1.4 km off.

On Esri imagery the loops (B-F) are centred at about 54.4692,-110.1255 (loop roads and pads visible); the agency's directions point is 54.469892,-110.121711. Suggested pin 54.4692,-110.1255.

WATERFRONT (stored not waterfront, confirmed): the loops are in forest 100-300 m from the shore (imagery estimate). No site is tagged near water on the booking site. The note's 'south shore' is the park's position on the lake, not the sites'.

ONE CAMPGROUND: the park has one campground (Loops A-F, plus a group camping area booked separately); no split candidate. The stored waterfront_evidence, if read at the stored pin, was read 1.4 km from the sites.
